meta.name: site-architecture
meta.description: When the user wants to plan, map, or restructure their website's page hierarchy, navigation, URL structure, or internal linking. Also use when the user mentions "sitemap," "site map," "visual sitemap," "site structure," "page hierarchy," "information architecture," "IA," "navigation design," "URL structure," "breadcrumbs," "internal linking strategy," "website planning," "what pages do I need," "how should I organize my site," or "site navigation." Use this whenever someone is planning what pages a website should have and how they connect. NOT for XML sitemaps (that's technical SEO — see seo-audit). For SEO audits, see seo-audit. For structured data, see schema.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划网站页面层级与导航结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要梳理网站页面组织方式或优化用户浏览路径。
copy.tagline_en: Plan your website's page hierarchy and navigation structure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to organize your website's pages or improve user navigation.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你规划网站结构，包括页面层级、导航、URL 格式和内部链接，并输出树状图、可视化站点地图和链接计划。
howto.when: 当你提到“网站结构”、“页面层级”、“导航设计”、“URL 结构”、“内部链接”等关键词，或询问如何组织网站页面时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个 SaaS 网站的页面层级和导航。
say.note: Claude 会询问业务背景并生成树状图。

say.text: 为我的博客网站设计 URL 结构和面包屑导航。
say.note: Claude 会给出 URL 模式示例和面包屑格式。

say.text: 检查我的网站内部链接，找出孤立页面。
say.note: Claude 会提供链接审计清单和修复建议。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you plan website structure including page hierarchy, navigation, URL patterns, and internal linking, outputting ASCII trees, Mermaid diagrams, and link plans.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "site structure", "page hierarchy", "navigation design", "URL structure", "internal linking", or ask how to organize website pages.

say_en.text: Plan the page hierarchy and navigation for a SaaS website.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about business context and generate an ASCII tree.

say_en.text: Design URL structure and breadcrumb navigation for my blog.
say_en.note: Claude will provide URL pattern examples and breadcrumb format.

say_en.text: Audit my internal links and find orphan pages.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a link audit checklist and fix suggestions.
